stories.h: Thanksgiving tide flooding forces rescues, evacuations in Brinnon
stories.s: King tides plus heavy rain sent up to 4 feet of water into parts of Brinnon on Hood Canal. Two women were rescued, Dosewallips State Park campers were evacuated, and many homes likely have water damage.

stories.h: Rare tornado warning hits King County's Eastside on Thanksgiving
stories.s: NWS Seattle briefly issued a tornado warning around midday Thursday for Issaquah, Snoqualmie and North Bend after a reported funnel cloud. No damage was reported and the warning expired at 12:15 p.m.

stories.h: Holiday storm cuts power, floods streets around Seattle
stories.s: Wind and heavy rain knocked out power to more than 1,000 Seattle City Light customers, restored by early afternoon, while leaf-clogged drains flooded streets in Burien and Seattle and minor flooding hit Browns Point.

stories.h: Pierce County probes ballot cure forms signed with checkmarks
stories.s: About two dozen ballot cure forms with checkmarks instead of signatures arrived, mostly from the 25th District race decided by 80 votes. Officials say no results changed; investigators will determine whether it was fraud or confusion.

stories.h: Holiday toll breaks end; normal weekday tolls return Friday
stories.s: I-405 and SR 167 express lanes were free for solo drivers on Thanksgiving, with weekend rates on SR 520, SR 99 and SR 509. Standard weekday tolls and HOV rules resume Friday morning.

talking.h: Darnold back fully; Purdy sits out 49ers practice
talking.s: Sam Darnold logged a second straight full practice on Thanksgiving and is set to start Sunday at San Francisco, while 49ers QB Brock Purdy did not practice with an ankle injury.

talking.h: Will Demond Williams Jr. stay at UW for 2027?
talking.s: Ahead of Saturday's game at Oregon, the Huskies' QB sidestepped questions about next season. Jedd Fisch is betting on keeping a young core, with 18 of 22 Indiana-game starters eligible to return.

talking.h: Conway's 'unofficial mayor' home after nearly 100 days with ICE
talking.s: Skagit County gas station worker Juan Gerardo Alatorre Martinez, a legal permanent resident, was released from the Tacoma ICE center; his lawyer suggests mistaken identity. A community fundraiser topped $20,000.

coming.s: The Wenatchee-area resort becomes Washington's first to open for 2026-27, running Chairs 1 and 2 Friday through Sunday on snowmaking and natural snow.

coming.h: Light rain Friday, then a dry weekend for return travel
coming.s: A much weaker system brings afternoon rain Friday; Saturday and Sunday look mostly dry, but models disagree on a possible rain-and-wind system Monday.

coming.h: Ferries: heaviest return sailings Saturday and Sunday
coming.s: WSDOT expects the longest waits on eastbound sailings leaving the islands Nov. 28-29; most highway construction is paused for the holiday weekend.
Washington (7-4) visits Autzen Stadium Saturday at 4:30 p.m. PT on NBC.

coming.h: Seahawks at 49ers in NFC West showdown
coming.s: Seattle plays at Levi's Stadium Sunday at 1:25 p.m. PT; Macdonald plans to start Sam Darnold.
Pierce County will hand-recount the House race between Jenn Marie Strickling and Rep. Cyndy Jacobsen.
